description:
**Due to the high level of interest in this property, please submit all enquiries via this website** Ritz Properties are delighted to present to the rental market this three bedroom semi detached home, situated in the popular LS8 area.

The property offers generous living accommodation throughout the ground floor, comprising a spacious separate living room through dining room and a fully fitted kitchen. 

To the first floor are two well proportioned double bedrooms and a spacious single bedroom. The accommodation is completed by a modern three piece family bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from ample off street parking and well maintained gardens to both the front and rear.

Ideally positioned, the property is within easy reach of the wide range of cafés, shops and local amenities available on York Road. Leeds City Centre is approximately 1.5 miles away, while the nearby A64 provides excellent transport links for commuters.

Rent £1400 PCM / Deposit £1615 / Available Now / EPC - TBC / Council Tax Band - B / Unfurnished.
